items.name: send-email
items.title: sendEmail (Resend)
items.description: Typed wrapper around Resend with React Email / HTML / plain-text body support and a dev-preview mode (logs the payload instead of sending). Reads from RESEND_API_KEY + RESEND_FROM_EMAIL env vars the framework already locks.

items.name: react-email-templates
items.title: BaseLayout + WelcomeEmail (React Email)
items.description: Shared BaseLayout wrapper (header logo, footer copyright, Tailwind-styled container) + a Welcome email template using it. Pair with `send-email` to ship a real transactional email in one install.
